submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image1 is the EDIT TARGET. It incorrectly has SIX distinct red talisman paper rectangles with six gold flame emblems. Remove the rightmost/lower-right outermost sixth talisman card only. After edit there MUST be exactly FIVE separate rectangular red cards, FIVE gold flame emblems and FIVE top card ends. Keep the remaining five original cards, their gold border art, fan arrangement and the existing right-hand grip position. Do not add a thin sixth card sliver behind them. Repaint only the small fan region and any tiny surface exposed by removal. Preserve image1 body pose, face expression, head/pony/crown pixel size and position, arms, hands, bronze bell, robe, legs, both shoe axes, stance and full-canvas composition as faithfully as possible. No pose resynthesis, no character resize or recenter, no change to the left-hand bell or right-hand talisman ownership. Image2 is identity, image3 approved rendering, image4 only confirms the FIVE-card structure; retain target pose. Output one native square RGBA transparent image at least1024 pixels; no background, ground, shadow, text, glow or detached effects. Target configuration GPT Image2.5 Sunburst/max is host-managed.
